briefdescription.para: Defines the register interface of the AXI Timebase and Window WDT.

detaileddescription.para: The xwdttb_hw.h header file contains identifiers and register-level core functions (or macros) that can be used to access the AXI Timebase and Window Watchdog Timer core.
For more information about the operation of this core see the hardware specification and documentation in the higher level driver xwdttb.h file.
